description: This file defines the React component 'GameContainer' which manages the core game logic of a Tic Tac Toe frontend application, including loading games, starting new games, handling moves, polling for game updates, and user interactions.

methods.name: GameContainer({ gameId = null, onLeaveGame })
methods.description: Main React functional component that handles game state, user interactions, and real-time updates.

methods.name: startGame
methods.description: Initiates a new game by calling backend API and sets up game state.

methods.name: pollGame
methods.description: Sets up polling to fetch game state periodically until game ends or waiting for a player.

methods.name: handleSquareClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a board square to make a move.

methods.name: handleJoin
methods.description: Allows a user to join an existing game as the second player.

methods.name: handleLeave
methods.description: Handles user leaving the game, resets state, and calls parent callback.
